probe.title: Sicilian Citrus Grove Experience | Agrumea Farm
probe.text_sample: Sicilian Citrus Grove Experience | Agrumea Farm Skip to content IT EN m m e e n n u u c c l l o o s s e e Experience An experience of places and flavours We believe that to truly understand the flavour of an orange or the intensity of a jam, you need to sink your feet into the soil where they were born. We invite you to discover our citrus grove not as spectators, but as protagonists. Among the scents of blossoming flowers and the gold of fruits ready for harvest, we have created paths designed for those who seek authenticity, the silence of nature and the pleasure of sharing. Discover our experiences Harvesting & Tasting Flavours & Tastings 01. The Golden Path (your basket) Duration 1 hour and 30 minutes The Experience Grab your basket, each guest will be able to pick citrus fruits directly from the tree to take home, learning how to recognise the perfect stage of ripeness. What’s included Guided walk through the rows of trees, explanation of the varieties and organic farming techniques. 02.
